correctness.rationale: Reconstructed fiber-wise forward-arc toggle matching: fixed nonempty backward B has full permitted forward simplex or none, empty B retains forward boundary sphere. Remaining backward-only simplices are precisely dominating sets whose triples of indices cover Z/n. Independently enumerated ALL dominating sets and all Hasse relations for n=4..20, with exact counts [4,8,15,27,50,92,169,311,572,1052,1935,3559,6546,12040,22145,40731,74916] and corresponding Hasse edge counts [3,10,25,54,120,256,534,1102,2245,4530,9071,18042,35682,70224,137612,268650,522711]. Reversed-toggle DAG acyclic in every case, with critical low-cell counts 2/0/1/1 in the four congruence classes. Inclusion of the full-forward S^{n-2} has a simplicial retraction; thus its degree-one H class prevents a nontrivial top attachment in the one-top-cell model via relative Hurewicz. Checked exceptional n=4 direct model and n=5 no low cell. Exhaustion proves exactly these seventeen cases, not periodicity beyond.
residual_risks: Finite n4..20 exhaustiveness depends on exact coverage predicate and DAG code; our reimplementation separately rebuilt both.
Relatively high-dimensional attachment nullity does not follow from reduced ranks alone; explicit forward boundary retraction plus Hurewicz is used.

value.rationale: Resolves an explicitly motivated finite stretch of a published open multipath family and upgrades ranks to integral homotopy, verifying six orders beyond the documented numerical range; an exact seventeen-order classification has standalone value without pretending infinite periodicity.
residual_risks: Does not prove a uniform formula for all n beyond twenty; high-cell retraction does not extend automatically to other puncture patterns.

limitations: Only n=4..20 inclusive and one specified reverse arc deleted; not an assertion for unpunctured cycles, double punctures or general directed graphs.
